evidence.source: Academia Sinica, Institute of History and Philology, Chinese Character Database
evidence.text: The entry identifies 亻 as U+4EBB and defines it as a variant positional writing of 人 (「人」的偏旁異寫). This supports the relation 人 → 亻 as a positional/full-form relationship, not as a claim that 人 is a historical ancestor newly substituted into 們.
evidence.title: 漢字「亻」：基本資料

evidence.text: The inspected page identifies the vector as 人 in Shuowen seal-script style, names Sinica Database among its sources, and states CC0 1.0. It is a modern vector rendering of a seal-style form, not an excavated artifact and not a 們 form.
evidence.title: File:人-seal.svg

evidence.source: Wiktionary contributors, Chinese character entry (secondary synthesis)
evidence.text: The entry analyzes 們 as phono-semantic, with semantic 亻 and phonetic 門. It reports Song-period plural-marker evidence and several spellings, and separately lists competing proposed origins. These statements support reporting a documented component analysis and reported semantic history, but do not settle the suffix’s derivation or supply an independently inspected dated primary occurrence.
evidence.title: 們 - 维基词典，自由的多语言词典

evidence.text: The official lookup documentation says the interface provides character-specific Unihan properties, including readings. It supports treating kMandarin as database reading metadata, not as evidence for an ancient phonetic relationship.
evidence.title: Unihan Database Lookup

evidence.field: sources/unihan/Unihan_Readings.txt; kMandarin rows 人, 亻, 門, 們, 们
evidence.text: Supplied exact local rows: 人 rén; 亻 rén; 門 mén; 們 men; 们 men. These current readings are not historical sound evidence. Official Unicode character-specific pages for 亻, 門, 們 and 们 failed to open in this invocation, so these local values are not represented as externally verified readings.
evidence.kind: local structured reading rows; not external evidence
evidence.title: Unihan Database Lookup

evidence.field: sources/baxter-sagart/baxtersagart.tsv; Baxter–Sagart 2014 rows for 人 and 門
evidence.text: Supplied local rows give 人 MC nyin, OC *ni[ŋ] and 門 MC mwon, OC *mˤə[r]. No row for 們 was supplied. The different readings do not by themselves establish or disprove 門’s proposed phonetic role in 們; the host lacks a matching reconstruction here.
evidence.kind: local structured reconstruction rows; not external evidence
evidence.title: Baxter-Sagart Old Chinese reconstruction, version 1.1 (20 September 2014)

search_audit.query: 亻 人 偏旁 字形 是 人 的 变形 侧旁 说文 现代汉语词典; 們 形聲 亻 門 字源 說文 宋代 用例 吕叔湘; site:unicode.org/cgi-bin/GetUnihanData.pl?codepoint=4EBB 亻 Unihan; site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File 人-seal.svg CC0 Shuowen seal 人
search_audit.outcome: Inspected the Sinica character entry, the secondary 們 entry, the official Unihan lookup documentation, and the Commons 人-seal file description. The Sinica entry explicitly supports 亻 as a positional form of 人. Then attempted the official Unicode per-character pages for 們, 们, 亻 and 門 and the Baxter–Sagart PDF; each failed to open. The 人 seal-style Commons page identifies its image, sources and CC0 terms.

gaps: No directly inspected primary Song or Tang passage establishes an exact dated occurrence, wording and sense for the plural suffix. The Song-period report and disputed Tang antecedents remain secondary-source reports.
No semantic path from proposed sources 輩, 門, 每人, 物, or the proposed Dravidian connection to the plural suffix is established by the inspected references.
No character-specific early form, graphic sequence, or corruption claim for 們 was established. The inspected seal-style image is 人 alone and is a modern rendering, not a 們 form.

Official Unicode per-character pages for 們, 们, 亻 and 門 failed to open in this run. Local supplied Unihan rows preserve current reading values but are not external citations or historical sound evidence.
No local Baxter–Sagart row for 們 was supplied, and the primary reconstruction PDF failed to open. The supplied 門 reconstruction therefore cannot establish historical sound matching with 們.
The Taiwan Ministry of Education dictionary page and other cited candidate glyph resources from the dossier were not newly verified in this pass.
